name: Repaglinide

fda.text: 5 WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS Hypoglycemia : Repaglinide may cause hypoglycemia. Skip the scheduled dose of repaglinide if a meal is skipped to reduce the risk of hypoglycemia. Reduce the dose of repaglinide if hypoglycemia occurs. (5.1) Serious Cardiovascular Adverse Reactions with Concomitant NPH-insulin : Repaglinide…

summary: Warnings for repaglinide note that it can cause hypoglycemia, which is low blood sugar, so doses should be skipped if a meal is missed or reduced if low blood sugar occurs [3]. The label also warns of serious heart-related problems when this drug is taken together with NPH-insulin [3]. Additionally, a small computer model rather than tests on people estimated low risk scores of 46 for the liver and 37 for the heart [M].
